extra.message: User input from the 'name' query parameter is directly concatenated into an HTML string (line 38) and rendered via Jinja2 Template.render() without auto-escaping (line 41). This allows reflected XSS attacks via payloads like /?name=<script>alert(1)</script>.

Hardcoded credentials found in config.py: SUPER_SECRET_NAME='John Ripper' and SUPER_SECRET_TOKEN='5u93R53Cr3tT0k3n'. These secrets are embedded in source code and could be extracted by anyone with access to the codebase.

The application makes an HTTP request to PUBLIC_IP_SERVICE_URL which is read from an environment variable (config.py line 11). If an attacker can control the environment variable, they could induce the server to make requests to internal services or malicious external servers (SSRF).

The FastAPI application has debug mode enabled based on the DEBUG environment variable (config.py line 9). When DEBUG=True, detailed error pages with stack traces and internal information may be exposed to users, aiding attackers.
